I ask about it like a week ago, I was following the group but it seems not to be an answer. 

Both my server and ui files are save with encoding UTF-8

(devtools::install_github("rstudio/shiny"))

Juan,

We put some fixes in this week that should hopefully resolve some the UTF8 encoding problems we have been seeing:

Can you update to the latest version of shinyapps by doing:

devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')

and then 

re-deploy your application:

deployApp()
